name: Kid Spatula
editorial_article: Kid Spatula is an alias of the prolific British electronic musician Mike Paradinas, widely recognized as one of the key figures in the 1990s and 2000s IDM and experimental techno scenes. Emerging as a distinct identity in 1995 with the release of 'Spatula Freak' on the American label Reflective—run by Kim Cascone—this project allowed Paradinas to explore more erratic and playful sound design compared to his flagship alias, μ-Ziq. While Paradinas is synonymous with the development of the Planet µ label, his work as Kid Spatula represents a specific, highly textural, and rhythmically complex corner of his vast discography. Following his debut, he revisited the Kid Spatula moniker in 2000 for the critically acclaimed album 'Full Sunken Breaks,' which showcased a maturation into dense, intricate breakbeat programming and atmospheric depth. The project serves as a perfect synthesis of the frenetic energy and intricate sound synthesis that defined the underground electronic music circuit of the era, standing alongside his other creative personas like Jake Slazenger. Through his use of this pseudonym, Paradinas demonstrated the sheer depth of his technical capabilities, carving out a space that is as challenging as it is deeply engaging for fans of experimental soundscapes.
